The triplets at 2.58 and 2.84 ppm indicate methylene groups (CH2) adjacent to each other, possibly part of an alkyl chain. The data suggests a structure with an aromatic ring, a methoxy group, and an alkyl chain. To confirm the presence of functional groups, I will check the IR spectra.</thought>
